notes: First route: Ibn Umar's own act (his halt at Dajnan and the crier's call) is described, not transmitted; as in rule 6's example, he is not a link, so the route ends at Nafi'.
«قال أيوب وحدثنا نافع عن ابن عمر أن رسول الله» is a second isnad with the same saying: Ibn Umar relays the Prophet's practice, so he is the last link of the second group (rule 4, rule 6).
